note: Served rows whose ruling holds only under a reading other than Hafs's (the note names the reading: «لمن قرأ …», «على قراءة …»). Classified by comparing each note with the Hafs text (gpt-6-luna, then every verdict read by hand; 25 of its 297 verdicts corrected). pipeline/audit_reading_side.py writes classical.reading='other' for these ids; the app labels them «على غير قراءة حفص». Keys are ids: منار and المكتفى are never rebuilt.
